meta.project: Bilingual, Ontology-Aware, and Explainable ESG Intelligence System
meta.description: Machine-persistable reference mapping linking integrated ESG research objectives and contributions to empirical literature evidence.

research_questions: RQ1.1: How can Transformer-based architectures be optimized for bilingual ESG ABSA?
RQ1.3: How can regional calibration and ESG lexicons mitigate bias?

literature_references.title: Improving Zero-shot Cross-lingual Transfer between Closely Related Languages by injecting Character-level Noise
literature_references.relevance: Provides the causal evidence that character-level noise improves zero-shot transfer for closely related languages, supporting C3 and the optimization of Indonesian-English transfer in RQ1.1.

literature_references.title: How Can Cross-lingual Knowledge Contribute Better to Fine-Grained Entity Typing?
literature_references.relevance: Supports RQ1.3 by proposing a mixture-of-experts approach to capture relationships between target and source languages, directly addressing regional calibration for ESG lexicons.

contributions: C8: Large-scale ESG LLM benchmark (30+ models)
research_questions: RQ2.1: How well do 30+ LLMs perform on ESG ABSA tasks?
RQ2.4: How can multi-LLM fusion reduce hallucination?
RQ2.2: How can long-context mechanisms enhance scalability?

literature_references.title: M-MAD: Multidimensional Multi-Agent Debate for Advanced Machine Translation Evaluation
literature_references.relevance: Establishes the LLM-as-a-judge framework used for C8 and RQ2.1 to evaluate complex multidimensional performance across distinct reasoning agents.

literature_references.title: RefreshKV: Updating Small KV Cache During Long-form Generation
literature_references.authors: Fangyuan Xu, Tanya Goyal, Eunsol Choi
literature_references.relevance: Provides technical grounding for C13 and RQ2.2 by demonstrating how flexible KV cache updates mitigate performance degradation in long institutional narratives.

research_questions: RQ3.1: How can symbolic reasoning be integrated using ESG ontologies?
RQ3.2: How can transparent outputs be ensured via reasoning graphs?
RQ3.3: How can implicit ESG claims be identified?

literature_references.title: Learning Reasoning Patterns for Relational Triple Extraction with Mutual Generation of Text and Graph
literature_references.authors: Yubo Chen, Yunqi Zhang, Yongfeng Huang
literature_references.relevance: Directly supports C7 and RQ3.2 by detailing a framework for constructing relational graphs to uncover implicit multi-hop reasoning paths in text.

literature_references.title: Improving Neural Political Statement Classification with Class Hierarchical Information
literature_references.relevance: Validates C15 and RQ3.1 by demonstrating that incorporating hierarchical ontological relations improves performance for infrequent and fine-grained categories.

research_questions: RQ4.5: Can tone–outcome mismatch reliably indicate greenwashing?
RQ4.1: How can XAI improve stakeholder trust in ESG outputs?

literature_references.title: Local Structure Matters Most: Perturbation Study in NLU
literature_references.relevance: Supports C11 and RQ4.5 by demonstrating model reliance on local structure, justifying the disentanglement of commitment/action tones to detect structural deception.

literature_references.title: Explaining Classes through Stable Word Attributions
literature_references.relevance: Provides the causal link for C4 and RQ4.1, establishing a framework for systematic attribution evaluation to enhance stakeholder trust in model decisions.

research_questions: RQ5.1: How can transparent and auditable outputs be ensured?
RQ5.2: How can reasoning quality and consistency be operationalized at scale?

literature_references.title: Using Interactive Feedback to Improve the Accuracy and Explainability of Question Answering Systems Post-Deployment
literature_references.relevance: Directly supports C12 by showing how interactive post-deployment feedback loops improve both performance and stakeholder decision readiness.

literature_references.title: La Leaderboard: A Large Language Model Leaderboard for Spanish Varieties and Languages of Spain and Latin America
literature_references.relevance: Establishes a precedent for C8 and RQ5.2 regarding community-driven, reproducible evaluation standards for language varieties and specialized domains.
